    <p>Tenzin Nyima, M.A., is a doctoral candidate in the Clinical Psychology Ph.D. program at Colorado State University. She received her Masters of Arts in Clinical Psychology from the University of Northern Iowa, and earned a Masters of Arts in Development (Public Health) from Azim Premji University in Bangalore, India. Her research interests focus on mental health and well-being, with an emphasis on systemic resilience, cultural humility, and their relation to workplace experiences, vocation, and career development among young adults and marginalized and underrepresented groups.</p>
